findings.reproduction: Run MobileInspectorSheet.test.tsx when opening an XML CFDI file in MobileInspectorSheet.
findings.expected: XML files resolve to the canonical 'code' format key labeled 'CFDI'.
findings.actual: resolveMobileFormat returned 'cfdi' instead of 'code', leaving the CFDI tab inactive in MobileInspectorSheet.test.tsx.
findings.cause: Format alias mismatch between desktop and mobile inspector format keys.
findings.fix: Mapped 'xml' to 'code' in MobileInspectorSheet.tsx while preserving the 'CFDI' display label.

findings.reproduction: Open /abrn/files at 1632x940 desktop width with Ecosystem Switcher and 3-skin selector in the topbar.
findings.actual: Duplicate md: ABRN Asesores wordmark and Enviar Carpeta topbar CTA compressed VaultOmnibar at 1632px.
findings.cause: Horizontal flex competition in dashboard-layout.tsx topbar.
findings.fix: Hid duplicate md: topbar wordmark (already shown in sidebar crest), moved Enviar Carpeta to min-[1800px]:inline-flex, and enforced min-w-[210px] on Omnibar.

findings.reproduction: Select Grupo Roche SA de CV on /abrn/files at 1632x940 with Center Module Switcher + Layout Presets + Telemetry Strip.
findings.expected: Client folder h1 displays 'Grupo Roche SA de CV' cleanly without truncating to 'Gr...'.
findings.actual: Subheader controls squeezed the client title below 120px.
findings.cause: Text labels on Layout Presets competed with the new Center Module Switcher below 2xl.
findings.fix: Set lg:min-w-[195px] on the folder h1 and hid Layout Preset text labels until 2xl while keeping crisp icons and tooltips.

findings.reproduction: Seed real CFDI XMLs in VaultReconcileCockpit or scan a PDF via Escanear Cel -> PC into a client folder created with FolderModal's 5-subfolder template.
findings.expected: CFDI XMLs route to '04 Facturas XML' and scanned PDFs route to '05 Entregables' matching FolderModal's canonical subfolder names.
findings.actual: Initial subfolder strings targeted '04 CFDI y Facturas XML' and '05 Entregables y Reportes', falling back to parent folder root.
findings.cause: Naming drift against FolderModal.tsx standard subfolder array.
findings.fix: Aligned VaultReconcileCockpit.tsx ('04 Facturas XML') and MobileScannerSheet.tsx / files.tsx ('05 Entregables') with FolderModal.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Switch Desktop skin to ◆ OLED while Dual en Vivo phone mirror is open.
findings.expected: Embedded phone mirror switches to #030712 OLED in 0ms alongside Desktop.
findings.actual: Phone mirror remained in Cream because mobile.html listens for type 'SKIN_CHANGE' with 'abrn-oled' rather than 'THEME_SYNC' with 'oled'.
findings.cause: Event payload schema difference between React skin IDs ('light'|'dark'|'oled') and mobile.html skin IDs ('abrn-light'|'abrn-dark'|'abrn-oled').
findings.fix: Added skinToMobilePreviewId and bidirectional SKIN_CHANGE packet forwarding in continuum-bridge.ts and ContinuumDockPane.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Press Cmd+K on /abrn/files while VaultTree (z-50) is visible.
findings.expected: CommandPalette backdrop blurs the entire viewport including Sidebar and VaultTree evenly.
findings.actual: VaultTree rendered unblurred at the same z-50 stacking level as CommandPalette.
findings.cause: CommandPalette rendered inline at z-50 instead of portaling above layout panes.
findings.fix: Portaled CommandPalette into document.body via createPortal at z-[70].

findings.reproduction: Open a CFDI XML seeded by VaultReconcileCockpit inside the 94vw FilePreviewModal.
findings.expected: FilemonOfficeStage parses the XML into the full SAT CFDI 4.0 Executive Glass Twin.
findings.actual: Strict XML DOMParser reported unbound cfdi: and tfd: namespace prefixes and fell back to raw source view.
findings.cause: buildRealAccountingSeedBatch omitted xmlns:cfdi and xmlns:tfd root attributes.
findings.fix: Added canonical SAT xmlns:cfdi and xmlns:tfd declarations to buildRealAccountingSeedBatch in VaultReconcileCockpit.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Open /abrn/files on physical Android 13 (427x721) across Pulso Fiscal and Expediente tabs.
findings.expected: Pulso Fiscal shows the #7a1f2b Apple-Wallet Client Pass + Cola de Trabajo Hoy + Floating Glass Dock cleanly above the fold, and Expediente has zero FAB overlap with the bottom dock.
findings.actual: Mobile FileSearch and file-list subheader pushed Pulso Fiscal down ~120px, and legacy FloatingActionButton overlapped the right side of abrn-floating-glass-dock on Expediente.
findings.cause: Legacy mobile subheader, FileSearch, and FloatingActionButton rendered unconditionally across ABRN mobile tabs.
findings.fix: Scoped mobile subheader and FileSearch to mobileHubTab === 'archivos' and gated FloatingActionButton to branding.logoVariant !== 'abrn' in files.tsx.
